guarantees.claim: On negedge rst_ni, fifo_wdata_sel_o is set to 0.
When clr_fifo_wdata_sel is high, fifo_wdata_sel_o is set to 0 (after reset).
When fifo_wsel_o and fifo_wvalid_o are both high and neither reset nor clr_fifo_wdata_sel, fifo_wdata_sel_o increments by 1.
guarantees.cond: fifo_wsel_o == 1 and fifo_wvalid_o == 1 and rst_ni == 1 and clr_fifo_wdata_sel == 0

guarantees.claim: Otherwise, fifo_wdata_sel_o retains its previous value.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni == 1 and clr_fifo_wdata_sel == 0 and not (fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o)

assumptions.claim: External logic must accept that clr_fifo_wdata_sel preempts the increment condition; if both are asserted, fifo_wdata_sel_o is cleared rather than incremented.
assumptions.cond: When clr_fifo_wdata_sel and (fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o) are simultaneously asserted.
assumptions.risk: Downstream logic might expect the counter to increment while being cleared, leading to misaligned fifo write selection.

assumptions.claim: fifo_wsel_o and fifo_wvalid_o are asserted only when a write to the target FIFO actually occurs and is accepted.
assumptions.cond: Any cycle where fifo_wsel_o && fifo_wvalid_o is true.
assumptions.risk: Spurious or premature assertions cause fifo_wdata_sel_o to increment incorrectly, leading to write pointer misalignment and data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: The counter fifo_wdata_sel_o may overflow if its width is insufficient for the maximum write count; increment wraps to zero, potentially selecting an unintended FIFO slot.
uncertain_points.cond: When fifo_wdata_sel_o reaches maximum value and another valid write occurs.
uncertain_points.risk: Corruption of HMAC data or control state due to incorrect write selection.
